card.name: Inside drug names, middle syllables
card.fires_on: The middle syllable of a drug name being spelled out, most often the 'oter' in formoterol. It also fires on syllables in cobicistat, isoniazid, telmisartan and ipratropium.

modes.label: formoterol
modes.description: The 'oter' syllable after 'form' or 'Arform' in the inhaled drug formoterol.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to aclidinium bromide or form<<oter>>ol fumarate

modes.description: A middle syllable inside other long drug names such as cobicistat, ipratropium, telmisartan and isoniazid.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words, so there is no clear link to the drug name's continuation.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, especially formoterol, before the name is finished.
